announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.7.0 — baru: plugin SketchUp "ARA Scene" (kunci rasio kamera, tombol simpan/perbarui scene di toolbar, ekspor semua scene sekaligus; dipasang otomatis ke SketchUp 2019–2026 lewat Sistem → SketchUp, bisa mematikan pop-up saat SketchUp dibuka). Edisi kantor: Proyek cukup "Pilih folder proyek" — folder render (mis. 007 RENDER) dan REV bertanggal dibuat otomatis, ekspor SketchUp masuk RAW RENDER, katalog material notasi dipakai bersama satu tim. Mode Cerita: SURPRISE ME kini memberi konsep foto utuh (momen + arahan komposisi & cahaya), pilihan PORSI ORANG supaya arsitektur tetap jadi bintang, dan panggung bisa memilih/menyembunyikan hasil. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.7.0 — new: the "ARA Scene" SketchUp plugin (lock the camera ratio, save/update scene buttons on the toolbar, export all scenes at once; installed automatically into SketchUp 2019–2026 via System → SketchUp, can silence pop-ups when SketchUp starts). Office edition: Project now only needs "Choose project folder" — the render folder (e.g. 007 RENDER) and dated REVs are created automatically, SketchUp exports land in RAW RENDER, and the notation material catalogue is shared across the team. Story Mode: SURPRISE ME now gives a full photo concept (moment + composition & light direction), a PERSON SIZE choice so the architecture stays the star, and the stage can pick/hide results. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
